advisoryMessages.lesson-puppy-socialisation: Follow your vet's vaccination and socialisation timing for your puppy.
advisoryMessages.lesson-fireworks-management: If your dog panics, injures themselves, or stops eating, contact your vet and seek qualified behaviour support.
advisoryMessages.lesson-reactive-management: Management only—not a treatment plan for aggression. See your vet first; use ABTC-registered help for ongoing reactivity.
advisoryMessages.lesson-emergency-recall: Practice in secure areas on a long line. Do not rely on emergency recall off-lead in public until tier-2 recall metrics are met.
advisoryMessages.lesson-rescue-settling: Rescue dogs may need extra time and professional support—avoid overwhelming new environments.
advisoryMessages.lesson-adolescent-regression: Teenage fear periods vary; reduce pressure and seek help if anxiety persists.
